evidence.claim: Partners with Rosenbauer to offer mobile firefighting and rescue solutions including the Panther 6x6, 8x8, and Commander series.
Assembles and supplies India's first "Make in India" Turntable Ladder with Rescue Lift, the Rosenbauer L42A-XS model.
Delivers high-capacity Emergency Crash Fire Tenders (ECFT), such as a 780 hp Volvo FH16 vehicle carrying 35,000L of water and 5,000L of foam.
Engineering design allows heavy firefighting trucks to accelerate from 0 to 80 km/h in 25–26 seconds while carrying a payload of about 50 tons.
Deploys high-performance pump systems capable of discharging 15,000 liters of extinguishing agent to a distance of 110 meters at 8,000 LPM.
Integrates smart digital control systems with fail-safe redundancies alongside specialized dual-agent fire suppression systems.
Features advanced aerial ladder stabilization tech that enables the rescue cage to navigate tight corridors with near-zero sway at height.
Operates a specialized vehicle manufacturing and assembly factory in Doddaballapura, Bangalore, which achieved over 60% indigenization by late 2024.
Conducts complex vehicle engineering including the full refurbishment of the world's largest operational firefighting vehicle for Goa International Airport.
Achieved the EN14043 Conformity Certificate from TÜV-SÜD Germany for continuous manufacture of turntable aerial rescue machinery.
Engineers specialized upper vehicle equipment to comply with international civil aviation safety criteria, maintaining strict ICAO standards.

Engineers specialized upper vehicle equipment to comply with international civil aviation safety criteria, maintaining strict ICAO standards.
Secured a ₹226.8 million domestic order directly from the Airports Authority of India (AAI).
Awarded a ₹93.5 lakh contract by the Home Department of Kerala for NFPA-standard fire fighting suits.
Delivered India's first "Make in India" Turntable Ladder with Rescue Lift to the Government of Goa.
Reported total revenue of ₹105.14 crore for FY26 compared to ₹50.23 crore in FY25, showing over 100% growth.
Registered an EBITDA of ₹9.80 crore and a PAT of ₹6.49 crore for the financial year FY25.
Operates a specialized manufacturing and assembly facility located in Doddaballapur, Bangalore, commissioned in February 2024.
Achieved over 60% indigenization in the localized manufacturing of Aircraft Rescue & Fire Fighting (ARFF) vehicles.
Operates an operational maintenance annuity network, including a five-year airport maintenance contract at Noida International Airport.
Expanded service reach through a ₹77.38 lakh crash fire tender AMC contract at Lokpriya Gopinath Bordoloi International Airport in Guwahati.
Acts as the exclusive long-term manufacturing partner in India for Rosenbauer International A.G. of Austria.

Incorporates advanced pump-and-roll operational capability alongside tire spray protection systems for extreme risk operating areas.
Equips first-responder apparatus with a cutting-edge Ultra High Pressure (UHP) mist system integrated with a 600-liter onboard tank.

Maintains international operational safety and quality benchmarks under ISO 9001:2015, ISO 14001:2015, and ISO 45001:2018 certifications.
